pages.text: Some recipes need $(thing)heat$(). Create gets it from the $(item)Blaze Burner$(), which also boosts basin recipes and powers steam engine boilers.$(br2)The burner is not crafted whole: you capture a living blaze in an $(item)Empty Blaze Burner$().

pages.title: Empty Blaze Burner
pages.text: Right-click a blaze with it to capture the blaze. Blazes can also be collected from their spawners. Then put the burner under a basin or boiler.

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Feed it flammable items by hand, or let a deployer or mechanical arm do it. It cools down when its fuel runs out.

$(thing)Two levels$(): fed with fuel it is $(bold)heated$(). Fed a $(item)Blaze Cake$() it becomes $(bold)superheated$(), the stronger tier some recipes need. A superheated burner also counts as heated.

pages.title: Blaze Cake
pages.text: Takes a burner to the stronger tier. Check JEI (R, U) for its recipe and the recipes that need superheating.

$(thing)What uses heat$():$(br2)$(li)Mixer and press recipes marked heated or superheated$(br2)$(li)Steam engine boilers: fluid tanks sitting on a burner heat water to steam$(br2)$(li)Fans: see $(l:create_basics/fans)Encased Fans$(/l) for what counts as a fan catalyst.

$(thing)Other mods$(): the tag Create reads for boiler heat also includes Farmer's Delight's $(item)Stove$(), Twilight Forest's fiery storage blocks, and lava, magma blocks, campfires and fire. These work as passive boiler heaters, weaker than a burner.$(br2)Create Additions' $(item)Blaze Burner with Straw$() takes liquid fuel by bucket or pipe.
